notes.title: Yomuneco participated in Tokyo VR Startups Season 2 demo day
notes.notes:
On March 30, the second phase demo day of Tokyo VR Startups (TVS) was held in Akihabara. TVS has invested in nine companies in total as an incubation program specialized for VR.
Demoday is an important opportunity to invite investment officials and media people to invite, to showcase the VR applications and services developed during the period, and to encourage further investment. VR startup related from the United States and South Korea also participated, it became content intense contents.
 
Yomuneco participated as a company elected in the 1st season(January to June 2016), also participated in the presentation and exhibition in the second phase (September 2016 - March 2017) demo day. We introduced what kind of activity we are doing after the presentation in Season 1. Of course, the latest demo was also exhibited, and the visitor actually played it.
 
Also on display, Professor Masahiko Inami of the University of Tokyo who is also one of TVS 'mentors also gave me an opening certificate as "VR game is very interesting".
 
I am writing an article of the demo day. We are pleased if you can read it.
(All Japanese Article)

notes.title: Enigma Sphere: Enhanced Edition version was release
notes.notes:
It is a 20% sale period for one week from today. Please play this timing! 
Enigma Sphere has 20 levels. In addition, there is an additional new level of Sphere Attack mode. Also, we prepare 3 different level, Normal, Hard and Hell. All mode will be opened after playing 30 minutes or clear 10 levels. 
We guess you play single at begging, but We are happy if you can enjoy Enigma Sphere by 2 multi-playing.


By the time of release, I received much cooperation from many people. Thank you again.
Of course, I will continue to do my best. Thank you!

By all means, I would appreciate it if you give us your frank opinions on playing.

notes.title: HTC VIVE Spring campaign started. You can get Enigma Sphere bundle first 1500 people in Japan
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28122971/7e0aa5abaecae969ffa05138c029db4c08669078.png[/img]
From March 24th, HTC VIVE Spring Campaign for Japan only has started. 
To 1,500 first-come-first-serve purchasers, two Japanese first high-end games will be given, one of which is "Enigma Sphere: Enhanced Edition". By using the coupon code in the package, you can get the Steam version scheduled to be released on March 31. Please take this opportunity to step into the high-end VR world.

Note: The image used in the HTC campaign is "Enhanced Version" in the image being produced, but eventually "Enhanced Edition" became the official name. There is no difference in the product contents.
